app.name: HSCode
app.tagline: Who makes what. Who needs what.

gate.signInBody: Add what each factory makes and needs, right from the field. Sign in with Google to start.
gate.offBody: Your account can't submit factories right now. Ask your supervisor to turn surveyor access back on.
gate.adminNote: Admins review submissions from the admin area.

invite.title: Enter your invitation code
invite.body: Your supervisor gave you a 6-digit code. You only need it once.
invite.invalid: This code isn't valid or was already used. Check the 6 digits with your supervisor.
invite.offline: You're offline — connect to unlock surveying
invite.unlockSlow: Your code was accepted, but your account hasn't updated yet. Reload the page to continue.

list.title: My submissions
list.empty: No factories yet. Tap Add factory to submit your first one.

location.title: Where is the factory?
location.hint: Tap the map where the factory is
location.gpsOff: Location is off. The pin starts at the centre of the selected area. Move it onto the factory before saving.
location.weak: GPS signal is weak. Move the pin onto the gate by hand.
location.required: Place the pin on the factory inside Egypt.
location.mustMove: Move the pin onto the factory before continuing.

basics.nameRequired: At least one name is required.
basics.areaOtherRequired: Enter the name of the area.

products.name: Product name
products.max: Up to {{max}} products in each list.

contacts.intro: Optional — skip anything the factory prefers not to share.

photos.intro: Up to 3 photos. The gate and signboard help the admin approve faster.
photos.failed: This photo couldn't be added — try the Camera button, or pick a JPEG photo

review.title: Check before you send
review.offlineBanner: You're offline. Saved on this phone, will upload when you're back online.
review.pinNotMoved: The pin wasn't moved from your GPS position — the admin will double-check.
review.weakGps: GPS was weak. The admin may double-check the location.

edit.notFound: This factory could not be found.

hs.title: HS code
hs.heading: Heading (4 digits)
hs.tariffHint: Enter the full 10-digit code only if you know it.
hs.skip: Skip, the admin will fill it
hs.searchPlaceholder: Search by product name or code
hs.enoughHint: That's enough — tap Use. The full tariff code is optional.
hs.tariffInvalid: Enter digits only, starting with the 6-digit code you picked.
hs.knowTariff: Optional — I know the full 10-digit code
hs.noResults: No matching heading. Try another word or a code.

errors.accessOff: Your surveyor access was turned off
errors.rejected: This factory couldn't be saved — open it and check the details.
errors.quota: HSCode is busy right now — please try again later
errors.indexFull: Search index is full — approving is blocked until space is freed.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.tooLong: Too long — use at most {{max}} characters.
errors.storageFull: This phone is out of storage for drafts — submit or delete old drafts.

admin.title: Superadmin

signIn.title: Admin sign in
signIn.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.

notAdmin.title: This account isn't an admin
notAdmin.body: Sign out and use the admin email and password, or continue to the survey.

admin.loadError: Couldn't load this list. Check your connection and reload.

invites.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. The code is selected, copy it by hand.
invites.cancelBody: Code {{code}} will stop working. This can't be undone.
invites.collision: Couldn't find a free code. Try again.

review.selectPrompt: Choose a submission from the list to review it.
review.notFound: This submission could not be found. It may have been deleted.
review.notPending: This factory is no longer pending, so it can't be approved or rejected here.

warn.title: Check this location
warn.lowAccuracy: GPS accuracy was ±{{m}} m, so the pin may be off. Check it is on the factory.
warn.manual: The surveyor placed the pin by hand, without a GPS fix.
warn.pinNeverMoved: The surveyor never moved the pin from the GPS position.

review.rejectHint: The surveyor will see this reason.
review.reasonRequired: Write a reason for the surveyor.
review.stale: This submission was just updated — reload to see the latest version.
review.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before approving.

surveyors.deactivateBody: They won't be able to submit factories.
